note: Provenance for every photograph on this site that we did not take ourselves. Each entry was verified by SHA-1: the local master is byte-for-byte the file at the source URL, so these are identity matches rather than resemblances. Licences were read off the file page's own wikitext and extmetadata, never inferred from a category, a filename, or a sibling file by the same author. CC BY-SA and NonCommercial files were excluded on purpose: the site applies a colour grade to every image, which creates a derivative, and share-alike would oblige the graded result to carry BY-SA too.

photographs.note: READ THIS BEFORE 'CORRECTING' THIS ENTRY. Wikimedia's Structured Data for this file still carries a stale CC BY-SA 4.0 copyright claim alongside the CC0 one, so any tool that reads Structured Data instead of the page wikitext will report this file as BY-SA — a licence we forbid. The operative licence is CC0. The file was uploaded in 2013 with an empty permission field; a third party tagged it BY-SA 4.0 in 2015 from the uploader's credit page; the author and sole copyright holder then dedicated it CC0 himself in the revision of 2022-09-03. A bot wrote the Structured Data claims in 2020, while the page genuinely said BY-SA, and later bot passes never purged the superseded value. CC0 is the only licence the author has personally written onto this page. Attribution is not legally required here; we credit him anyway.
